items.title: Public Advisory Consultation: 280 Green Street
items.summary: Review of a proposal to replace a 2-story building with a 5-story, 9-unit residential building in the Central Square Overlay District. The public can give non-binding recommendations.

items.title: Update on Central Square Rezoning
items.summary: City planners return to the Central Square Advisory Committee to discuss feedback on updating zoning for Central Square. Residents can attend in person or on Zoom, or send written comments before the meeting.
